sourceContext.originPage: sidebar-listing FAQ page (Individual and Family (ACA) FAQ)

contentPattern.structure: one row per Q&A item: cell 1 = question label, cell 2 = answer body (paragraphs, bulleted lists, inline links)

suitableFor: light-styled FAQ accordions on white content pages
grouped FAQ pages under /resources/answers/faq/* (one accordion block per group heading)
any expandable question/answer list on a light background
notSuitableFor: dark-themed accordions on colored/dark bands (create an accordion-minimal-dark variant instead)

notes: NEW variant. No existing accordion variant was present in blocks/ (only the vanilla 'accordion'); the FAQ on the sidebar-listing pages is light-styled (white background, light-blue tinted open answer panels, dark-blue text), so a light variant was created rather than reusing a non-existent dark one. Built on the vanilla accordion base with renamed CSS classes and matching JS class names. Authoring model unchanged from vanilla: one row per Q&A item (question | answer). On grouped FAQ pages, each H2 group heading and 'BACK TO TOP' link are default content between separate accordion blocks. Reusable across all sidebar-listing / sidebar-faq / sidebar-grouped-faq FAQ pages.
